new_series.title: The Celebrity Inner Circle
new_series.synopsis: Ade Adepitan, Janette Manrara, Des Clarke, Catherine Tyldesley and Lisa Riley are paired with five contestants hoping to outwit each other to win big.

new_series.title: Antiques Road Trip
new_series.synopsis: Regulars Tash and David hit the road together for the first time in central Scotland. There are finds from East Asia and significant sparkles, but what will fly at auction?

new_series.title: Pointless
new_series.synopsis: Alexander Armstrong is joined by co-host Lucy Porter for the quiz where contestants try to score as few points as possible by coming up with the answers no-one else could think of.

new_series.title: Hey Beautiful: Anatomy of a Romance Scam
new_series.synopsis: Women worldwide are falling for the same online lover. But when he starts to ask for money, Roxy, Annette and Gaby trace the truth back to a single man in California.

new_series.title: Schitt's Creek
new_series.synopsis: While Moira is in Bosnia filming the Crows movie that she hopes will revive her acting career, David attempts to take his relationship with Patrick to new heights.

new_series.title: The Banksy Story
new_series.synopsis: What happens when Banksy does one of his naughty drawings on your wall? James Peak investigates. Let's meet Sam in Margate and Gert in Lowestoft. Banksy has visited them both.

new_series.title: The Good Earth by Pearl S Buck
new_series.synopsis: Wang Lung and O-Lan marry, work the land and raise their family. When drought brings famine and turns fortune to ruin, they are forced into a desperate fight for survival.

new_series.title: Shadow World
new_series.synopsis: People have called Dr Ittai Gradel a kind of Sherlock Holmes, if Holmes were Danish and obsessed with gems. He’s an antiquities dealer with an eye for stolen goods.

new_series.title: Understand
new_series.synopsis: Ros Atkins investigates how technology is changing what we value, from friendship and culture to finance and work, and asks whether these changes amount to a crisis.

new_series.title: The History Podcast
new_series.synopsis: 21 April, 1945, Eastern Germany, a plane crashes. A few iron boxes are salvaged.  Rumour spreads that Hitler’s personal effects are in those boxes. Could there be diaries?

new_series.title: Limelight
new_series.synopsis: A new tutor arrives in a luxury bunker. What happened to her predecessor? Claustrophobic near-future thriller set in a billionaire’s haunted bunker.
